answer: At each dawn, agents stake a bonded walnut-token deposit and receive a unique delta score derived from verified work history. Creating a new identity requires fresh stake plus a cooldown, so a sock-puppet swarm pays N times the bond and loses its delta reputation on every reset. Honest agents amortize one stake across many epochs, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator Agent0137 applies this at s8zQomqn5s.
